name: schedule-meeting
description: Slash command to schedule meetings via Grok

examples.input: /schedule-meeting title: 'Team Sync' duration: '1 hour' participants: 'team@example.com' times: 'Mon-Wed 2-4 PM'
examples.output:
Scheduled: Team Sync
Time: Monday 2-3 PM
Participants: team@example.com
Calendar event created

usage: Use /schedule-meeting in Grok chat to schedule meetings
